implementation.name: original-v3-hierarchical-budget
implementation.scope: Canonical dollar balances from the original figure. JavaScript uses integer mills to preserve the displayed budget; logical animation does not model billing time.
implementation.question: Why does stopping a child release no root funds?

purpose: Why does stopping a child release no root funds?
guard: No reservation is released on local stop. Canonical values use integer mills; E+R+F always equals the root budget. Idempotent final billing cannot create extra free funds.
